title: Reusable offline project map
summary: Provide a reusable upstream generator that reads one catalog revision and outputs an offline map. The verified Veraphify workflow is adopter evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Include Ideas and Features in their respective category views and render disconnected records.
Preserve directed links and produce identical output for repeated runs on the same inputs.

evidence.claim: The Veraphify adopter workflow generated and retained the map after a repeat build.
